first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and is supported by two inherited findings linking less friction to stronger activation and early adoption. I would verify memory_86 as the closest evidence and memory_73 as the strongest alternative given competitive pricing pressure, especially because its pooled-cohort caveat leaves uncertainty about sustainable qualified revenue. Current intent favors onboarding over discounting to improve durable value without introducing pricing-related quality or retention risk.
